title: BigP3BCI Study F — 6x6 multi-paradigm, 3 sessions (10 healthy subjects)
description: BigP3BCI Study F is a derivative EEG dataset comprising P300-based brain-computer interface recordings from 10 ALS patients across 3 sessions using a 6x6 character grid speller paradigm. The dataset contains 16-channel EEG data sampled at 256 Hz with visual stimulus presentations annotated using HED 8.4.0 schema, designed for P300 event-related potential detection and BCI speller applications. This dataset represents Study F of the BigP3BCI dataset.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels in standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz sampling rate. Subjects (ALS patients) performed a P300 speller task with visual stimulus presentations in a 6x6 character grid format. Data were processed and organized using MOABB (Mother of All BCI Benchmarks) version 1.5.0 according to BIDS 1.9.0 standards with HED 8.4.0 event annotations.
